intent: R2dbcSessionStoreTest executes the REAL migrated V3 DDL on embedded H2 and asserts rows back: saved session loads for its owner and tenant (SI-01 permitted); a VALID session id with a foreign user or tenant is not found and permits is false (cross-owner); each case seeds a UNIQUE session id; PB-07 pool maximum read from spring.r2dbc.pool.max-size equals 10.

methods.signature: Mono<ChatSession> byIdAndTenant(String sessionId, String ownerUserId, String tenantId)
Mono<Boolean> permits(String sessionId, String userId, String tenantId)
methods.semantics: true when the session exists for that user and tenant; false when absent or owned by another
